Physically and mentally healthy, with excellent academic performance; 4. Those who are interested in engaging in Chinese language education, teaching and related fields; 5. Age range: 16 - 35 years old (calculated as September 1, 2025). For in-service Chinese teachers, the age limit is relaxed to 45 years old. For applicants for the undergraduate scholarship, the age should generally not exceed 25 years old.Enrollment in September 2025, with a funding period of 11 months. The professional direction is divided into two categories: (1) In the field of international Chinese education, the Chinese language examination score must reach 270 points in HSK (Level 3) and possess HSKK score. (2) Major in Chinese Language and Literature, Chinese History, or Chinese Philosophy. The Chinese language test score must reach 180 points in HSK (Level 4) and 60 points in HSKK (Intermediate Level). (3) For the Chinese language training program, candidates must achieve a HSK (Level 3) score of 210 or higher. Those who have obtained a HSKK score will be given priority.
